fixedRegulatoryDates.title: Amended COPPA Rule compliance deadline
fixedRegulatoryDates.obligation: Written data-retention policy with enforced deletion; written information security program; expanded PI (voiceprints, audio); separate verifiable parental consent for disclosure not integral to the service, explicitly including using children's data to train AI.
fixedRegulatoryDates.action: Verify ongoing compliance each quarter (rev-coppa-retention-quarterly). Penalties up to ~$51,744/incident/day.

fixedRegulatoryDates.title: EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations apply
fixedRegulatoryDates.obligation: Disclose AI interaction to users; label synthetic/AI-generated content; deepfake identification. Applies to ANY in-scope AI system, not only high-risk. For an AAC predictor, the relevant question is whether output meets the synthetic-content marking trigger.
fixedRegulatoryDates.action: Before 2026-08-02: document the Article 50 applicability analysis for the AAC predictor in the AI Governance Memo; implement any required user-facing AI-interaction disclosure.

fixedRegulatoryDates.title: EU AI Act Article 50(2) machine-readable marking grace ends
fixedRegulatoryDates.obligation: Generative AI systems already on the market before 2026-08-02 must meet the machine-readable marking-of-output requirement by 2026-12-02 (May-2026 Digital Omnibus grace period).
fixedRegulatoryDates.action: Only relevant if the AAC predictor is deemed to generate markable synthetic content; resolve in the Article 50 applicability analysis.

fixedRegulatoryDates.title: ADA Title II web accessibility - large public entities
fixedRegulatoryDates.obligation: WCAG 2.1 AA for web content of large public entities (April-2026 IFR extended the date). Small entities: 2028-04. LingoLinq is a vendor, but district customers flow WCAG down via RFP today.
fixedRegulatoryDates.action: Keep the ACR/VPAT current; treat WCAG 2.1 AA as a present sales requirement regardless of the federal date.

fixedRegulatoryDates.title: EU AI Act Annex III high-risk obligations apply
fixedRegulatoryDates.obligation: High-risk obligations for Annex III systems (deferred from earlier by the Digital Omnibus). An AAC word predictor is plausibly NOT Annex III point 3 (it does not gate admission, assess learning, or proctor) - but that must be a documented memo, not an assumption.
fixedRegulatoryDates.action: Maintain the Annex III classification memo in the AI Governance Memo; revisit if product scope moves toward education-gating functions.

fixedRegulatoryDates.title: European Accessibility Act microenterprise exemption threshold
fixedRegulatoryDates.obligation: EAA enforceable since 2025-06. LingoLinq is likely inside the microenterprise exemption (<10 staff AND <EUR 2M turnover/balance sheet). The exemption vanishes the day EITHER threshold is crossed.
fixedRegulatoryDates.action: Re-check exemption status at each headcount or revenue milestone; if crossed, EAA accessibility obligations attach to EU-facing services.
